verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.slack.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and describes itself as the official Slack developer documentation. The docs also offer an llms-full variant (llms-full-deno.txt), Markdown versions of pages (quickstart.md, block-kit.md, node-slack-sdk.md), and a dedicated 'build with AI' guide. Missing for 10: no independent or community report of agents actually using these files, and little detail on how much of the docs llms.txt covers.
